title: Supported Decision Making for Alaskans FY27
description: This course is provided through the State of Alaska Governor’s Council on Disabilities and Special Education (GCDSE). Anne Applegate, formerly with the GCDSE highlights key components in the design of Alaska’s supported decision making legislation. Supported Decision Making Agreements (SDMA) are written agreements which provide individuals the help and support they request to make choices about their lives. SDMAs can be used in conjunction with Guardianship and Conservatorship.
